thread:
Rae (Design): Noticed a recurring issue: in the compact trace card the corr-id pill, tiny download glyph, and tooltip are all inside a very small tap target. Mobile users end up downloading when they meant to copy. Anyone else seeing this? :grimacing:
Omar (EngRuntime): Yep, support has a few tickets about accidental downloads. The download triggers a snapshot endpoint that can be expensive.
Priya (Product): Do we have metrics on where downloads start? compact vs detail? If compact is a big source we should rethink inline affordance.
Rae (Design): Quick check: ~27% of trace downloads originate from compact cards over last 30 days. Proposal: make corr-id a single-action copy (tapping copies), move download into an overflow menu (kebab). Add an inline keyboard hint: "focus + C".
June (Accessibility): Strong +1 for separating primary and secondary actions. Add aria-label="Copy correlation id", aria-describedby for helper text, and a polite aria-live region that announces "Correlation ID copied to clipboard". For kebab/menu use aria-haspopup/aria-expanded and role=menu.
Rex (EngPlatform): Dev plan: kebab after corr-chip, roving tabindex, menu navigable with arrows, Esc closes. I'll add client-side debounce and server-side rate limiting for exports. Also show a toast: "Preparing download..." and spinner on long exports.
Omar (EngRuntime): Backend: large traces should return 202 + job id and a polling endpoint. Avoid synchronous export work. Add size threshold (e.g. >5MB) that requires explicit confirm.
Priya (Product): UX tradeoff: hiding download reduces accidents but may affect discoverability. Keep prominent download on the full detail page and move it into kebab on the compact card. Capture telemetry: click source (compact vs detail) and confirm counts.
Rae (Design): I'll prepare two mocks: A) corr-chip primary copy + kebab with "Download trace JSON" labeled "Download trace JSON (compressed)". B) inline tiny icon with first-click confirm modal and undo toast. I'll annotate a11y behaviors.
June (Accessibility): Prefer kebab-only for simpler SR experience. If we use confirm modal, ensure focus trap and announcements. Also verify the keyboard shortcut doesn't collide with browser/assistive tech.
Rex (EngPlatform): I'll own keyboard behavior and NVDA/VoiceOver test passes. Also implement server-side export guard and progress job flow.
Omar (EngRuntime): I'll wire the export endpoint to return job status and stream compressed payload when ready.
Priya (Product): I'll update docs and support notes, and draft a release blurb.
Rae (Design): Plan: post final mock in #design by tomorrow EOD and tag @Rex @Omar for implementation. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder: design-review in #design 2024-11-05 15:00 UTC
Priya (Product): tagging @June for a11y sign-off after tests.
June (Accessibility): Will sign off after NVDA + VoiceOver passes (expect ~1 business day post-PR).
notes: Thread records design decision to move heavy download into overflow, make corr-id a primary copy action with keyboard hint, add aria-live confirmation, backend 202+job export flow, telemetry, and mock variants.
